name: surf-reel
description: Real beach footage cut to skate-punk surf rock: calm muted discovery intro, band drop on the shirt reveal, beat-synced punch/shake/whip/caption-slam cuts, product card on the final hit. 9:16 only.
music_prompt: Gritty skate punk surf rock instrumental, 150 BPM, distorted surf guitar with reverb twang, driving punk drums, heavy tom hits, hard-hitting fight-night energy, raw garage production, starts with a single reverb guitar sting then the full band drops in hard around 3 seconds, ends on a hard stop
